section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single 3-hour experiment involving 64 3-person teams. The study investigated how team composition (cognitive ability, goal orientation) and goal difficulty influenced team adaptation to unforeseen changes. It found that teams with difficult goals and high-performance orientation members were less likely to adapt, while those with high-learning orientation members were more likely to adapt.
